// ABOUT: TypeScript type checking after file modifications
// USAGE: Copy the PostToolUse section into your settings.json hooks. The matcher is the tool name (Edit|Write); the command guards on extension.
// NOTE: This may slow down editing - consider using only for critical files

PostToolUse.// DESCRIPTION: Type check the project after editing TypeScript

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true;; esac
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit "$FILE" 2>&1 | head -10 || true;; esac
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --build --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true;; esac

// TIPS: Type checking the entire project can be slow on large codebases
Consider using --incremental in tsconfig.json for faster checks
Use the single-file variant for faster feedback during development
The '|| true' ensures the hook doesn't block on type errors
